question: Who among the following was appointed as the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd. in January 2021?
solution: The correct answer is **__Ram Mohan Rao Amara.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Rama Mohan Rao Amara was appointed as the** MD and CEO of SBI Card**. • His appointment is with effect from 30 January **2021 for a period of two years**.
